name: Bridgit Sissons
story: At a Women in Spatial event on 24 October 2018, Bridgit Sissons of Engineering New Zealand spoke about the Diversity Agenda. Fifty members then discussed challenges specific to the spatial industry; the group reported that some members took the discussion back to their workplaces. The event account does not present the engineering-wide statistics in her talk as GIS workforce data.
